scientific_integrity: Full characteristic polynomial derived from incidence Gram decomposition and Ihara–Bass. Integer computations corroborate finite cases, and are not claimed as exhaustive or independent.
scientific_limitations: Only one-edge subdivisions of balanced complete tripartite graphs; two-sided universal-cover spectral criterion, not one-sided Ramanujan. General spectral identities and the universal bound are established prior results. Priority provisional and independent validation not performed.
title: Sharp lower-edge escape among minimum-real-spectrum non-backtracking Laplacians
